# V3 App Folder

This folder contains the active V3 stormwater BMP comparison app.

## Source files
- `index.html` is the main V3 entry point.
- `style.css` is the shared V3 app stylesheet.
- `app.js`, `flow.js`, `ui-inputs.js`, `run-analysis.js`, `report-view.js`, `state.js`, and related modules are source files.
- `resources.html` and `resources-catalog.js` power the collateral/resource hub.
- `admin-editor.html` is the source admin editor.

## Generated files
- `v3-standalone-test.html` is generated by `build-standalone.js`.
- `admin-editor-standalone.html` is generated by `build-admin-editor.js`.
- `stress-test-report.json` is generated by stress testing.

Do not hand-edit generated files unless you intentionally do not plan to rebuild them. Prefer editing the source files and rerunning the build script.

## Cleanup rule
Before moving files out of this folder, check `index.html`, the build scripts, and any `window.open()` calls in the V3 scripts.
